title: Scalar reduction inputs require splatting before a Triton fold

evidence.scope: CPU isolated native compilation. The component batch stopped before GPU allocation. singleton-native-probe-001 retained a source-projection refusal and did not test the scalar operation.

observation: The all-register Cosine control reached MACA Triton reshape with a rank-zero value. semantic.reshape reads input.type.numel, but scalar dtype has no numel. A strict CPU execution double reproduces this for 16 producer/op/dtype subcases. In isolated native probes both sum and max fail with reshape and compile with broadcast_to. MACA broadcast_impl_shape splats a scalar and preserves an already matching [1] block.
proposed_change: Normalize a logical [1] reduction input with broadcast_to(value, (1,)), then retain the declared sum/max and accumulator cast. Keep register-storage admission and all non-singleton reductions unchanged. Make the CPU execution double reject scalar reshape so this actual toolchain boundary remains covered.
promotion_disposition: Promote the scalar-to-block normalization to shared Triton lowering. No IR vocabulary, arithmetic rewrite, target fact or new backend capability is introduced. Device numerical and performance validation remain separate.

principles_review.P1_P3: No author syntax or alternate canonical IR form is added.
principles_review.P2_P8: The emitted splat is explicit and follows the observed toolchain scalar/block contract.
principles_review.P4_P5_P7: Existing typing, placement admission and reduction analyses are retained.
principles_review.P6: Affected reduction/emitter contracts and unchanged full Corpus expectations gate this change.

verified_by.regression_before_fix: cac86ee0: test_chained_register_reductions_keep_values_for_scalar_and_block_producers fails in 16 subcases after the execution double refuses scalar reshape.
verified_by.tests: 84 passed: test_triton_reduction_storage, test_triton_loop_scopes, test_emit_triton, test_triton_sequential_regions, test_triton_multi_mma
verified_by.native_probe: singleton-native-probe-002 compares identical source and requirements from 3f6be196 with only singleton reshape versus broadcast_to. sum and max reshape fail; sum and max broadcast_to compile to mcfatbin in the existing isolated CPU compiler.
verified_by.scope: Successor CPU regression and Corpus pass; minimal native compile confirms the operation choice. Full retained-Cosine device qualification and performance remain pending in the platform successor.
